pairs: I have lifted up my soul.
I trust. Let me not be put to shame.
And do not let my enemies laugh at me.
etenim universi qui sustinent te, non confundentur.
For all who remain with you will not be confounded.
Confundantur omnes iniqua agentes supervacue. Vias tuas,
May all those who act unjustly over nothing be confounded. O Lord,
quia tu es Deus salvator meus,
For you are God, my Savior,
and I remain with you all day long.
remember your compassion and your mercies,
et misericordiarum tuarum quæ a sæculo sunt.
Delicta juventutis meæ, et ignorantias meas, ne memineris.
Do not remember the offenses of my youth and my ignorances.
Secundum misericordiam tuam memento mei tu,
Remember me according to your mercy,
The Lord is sweet and righteous.
propter hoc legem dabit delinquentibus in via.
he will grant a law to those who fall short in the way.
He will direct the mild in judgment.
He will teach the meek his ways.
Universæ viæ Domini, misericordia et veritas,
All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth,
requirentibus testamentum ejus et testimonia ejus.
to those who yearn for his covenant and his testimonies.
Quis est homo qui timet Dominum?
Which is the man who fears the Lord?
legem statuit ei in via quam elegit.
He has established a law for him, on the way that he has chosen.
His soul will dwell upon good things,
and his offspring will inherit the earth.
The Lord is a firmament to those who fear him,
et testamentum ipsius ut manifestetur illis.
and his covenant will be made manifest to them.
My eyes are ever toward the Lord,
quoniam ipse evellet de laqueo pedes meos.
for he will pull my feet from the snare.
Respice in me, et miserere mei,
Look upon me and have mercy on me;
quia unicus et pauper sum ego.
for I am alone and poor.
The troubles of my heart have been multiplied.
Vide humilitatem meam et laborem meum,
See my lowliness and my hardship,
and they have hated me with an unjust hatred.
for I have hoped in you.
The innocent and the righteous have adhered to me,
because I have remained with you.
